data.one_liner: A plugin for lazily loading ttf and otf fonts from the native side.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to request font data dynamically from the native platform (iOS and Android). It uses Flutter's FontLoader to load fonts asynchronously and automatically refreshes text once the font data is provided from the native side.
use_when: You need to load fonts dynamically or lazily from native resources.
You want to share native font handling between iOS and Android codebases.
avoid_when: You can bundle all your fonts directly within Flutter assets.
You are looking for a complete pre-built font repository package like google_fonts without writing native bridge code.
strengths: Supports lazy loading of ttf and otf font formats.
Automatically refreshes text when font data is loaded asynchronously.
Includes fallback mechanisms if the font cannot be found or loaded.
weaknesses: Requires writing native implementation code in Swift/Objective-C and Java to handle font data callbacks.
Limited documentation outside of basic usage examples.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding platform-specific implementation code in Swift, Objective-C, or Java to handle the font data handler callbacks.
